title: One Fire, Three Tellings: The Night Musa Went to Borrow a Flame
excerpt: Musa announced the fire to his family once — the Quran quotes him three times, differently. Guidance in Ta-Ha, news in An-Naml, an ember in Al-Qasas: each surah keeps the piece of his sentence it needs. And the rare words in his shopping list echo in places you would never expect.
seo_title: Why Does the Quran Tell Musa's Fire Story Three Different Ways? (20:10, 27:7, 28:29)
seo_description: Musa's fire announcement appears in Ta-Ha, An-Naml, and Al-Qasas with different wording. A corpus-verified reading: what never changes, what each surah keeps, and where the rare words (qabas, jadhwa, khabar) reappear.
